verdict.rationale: Sill's repo documents clicks, momentum scrolling, an on-screen trackpad, keys and typed text, and Pencil-as-pointer reaching the Mac. An attached hardware keyboard types on the Mac, Esc included, and three-finger gestures trigger Mac trackpad actions like Mission Control. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that input is injected as native host events, evidence for a physical mouse attached to the viewing device, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, mouse, keyboard, and scroll input from the viewing device lands on the host as native events
